method.pipeline: Actual original files, Office extraction / frozen real PDFium extraction, SQLite ingestion, E5 ONNX INT8, Qdrant, real Qwen tokenizer, QueryService and native Ollama Qwen3-4B. Eleven paired cases use direct QueryService transport. The separate http_transport section retains one candidate-only HTTP/SSE/version test.
method.design: One submission per case and revision in fixed manifest order; independent conversations. Synthetic development-derived sources plus two point-mismatch model-call probes and two simple text-native PDFs. Not a heldout native corpus.
method.baseline_repair: First block completed 10 cases. NP03 failed in harness scope construction before a query existed. The explicit two-document scope and question did not change; add required document_key metadata. Keep all first 10 answers; run only the missing NP03 in a fresh process/service block. Eleven completed responses arise from twelve attempts.
method.cost_comparison: Baseline NP03 is a deterministic 672.10 ms result from a fresh supplement process. It is not a paired cold/warm model timing. Native heavy blocks ran sequentially; lightweight contract tests and reviews overlapped CPU measurements. Timings are observed costs, not a controlled performance gain claim.
method.quality: Exact-support labels frozen in native inputs. Whole-question accepted_complete requires contract status covered. Partial is separate from complete support; literal fidelity and manual invalid-operand review are independent columns. Quoting a bound literally does not make it an exact value.
method.review: Independent scientific_review agent manually assessed every completed baseline and candidate answer, actual source facts and citations; checks values, units, subjects, conditions, comparison and negative operand admission. This is not expert human validation.
method.retrieval: Same-document literal passage presence in initial top 10 and retained context, checked independently of support decisions. Explicit one/two-document scopes and tiny synthetic corpus limit interpretation.
method.model_call_evidence: Count only a matching llm.request plus hash-chain-verified llm.response received_done=true and response_capture_complete=true and positive terminal eval_count. model_called alone is insufficient. output_tokens is configured output budget, not emitted token count; eval_count is the received generation count.

model.name: Qwen3-4B
model.execution: CPU requested (num_gpu=0), llm_execution mode=cpu observed. Actual request parameters and verified identity source (/api/tags or /api/ps, as recorded) retained per call. Factual requests use num_predict=768, comparison requests 1536. Server flash_attention / kv_cache_type are requested, server_options_verified=false; do not call these verified allocations.

method.latency_statistics: Arithmetic median; p95 nearest rank sorted[ceil(0.95*n)-1]. With n=11, p95 equals the maximum. One pass, no uncertainty interval or speedup inference; heterogeneous deterministic/model route mixture.
method.memory: Application process, explicitly supplied Ollama/Qdrant service processes and descendants sampled every 0.5 s via psutil. RSS sums can duplicate shared pages; PSS and USS shown separately. Includes initialization/ingestion and all queries at block level. Sampler skips unreadable/exited processes and does not certify enumeration completeness; sample peaks can miss shorter spikes. Minimum available is host memory, not process headroom or a target-device guarantee.
method.privacy: Only explicitly selected synthetic document data, output assessments, hashes, public model parameters and telemetry retained. No profile contents, Qdrant credentials, raw request messages, private service config, Ollama store metadata or environment secrets are published.
limits: No OCR claim: both PDFs have native text.
The eleven paired native cases do not exercise HTTP. The separate candidate-only HTTP01 case exercises transport/publication/version persistence; no browser or UI qualification.
No hardware qualification beyond the recorded Linux host.
Heldout H24 false acceptance remains in the separate support report; native 0/7 does not supersede that failed gate.
The exact comparison false rejection N_D11 remains in both revisions.
Four additional partial cases invoke the 4B model: safety improvement has a substantial observed latency and call-count cost.
